name: Philip G. Martin
occupation: Platte County coroner (serving through the current term, which ends in January 2027)
prior_offices: Platte County coroner (won the November 2022 general election)
background: Philip G. Martin is the Platte County coroner, serving through the end of the current term in January 2027. He won the November 2022 general election. Incoming coroner Tiffany Gorman Dean takes office in January 2027. No mid-term resignation or appointment was found in the public records reviewed for this Profile.
